name: Yea Big, Yea High
summary: Selecting surfaces and regions in VR by progressive refinement, sketching the extent of the selection with the hands.
howItWorks: The user roughly indicates the size and position of the region with both hands, then narrows the selection in further steps until it covers the intended surface.
